title: Backup, DR & Migration
description: Pre-incident visibility into backup freshness, verification status, active migration progress, and contract state-version consistency. Cross-linked from docs/contract-upgrade-strategy.md and docs/migration-invariants.md. Use this dashboard as a trend view before PagerDuty fires; the alerts.yml rules (BackupMissing, BackupVerificationFailed, MigrationStalled, StateVersionMismatch) are the paging layer.

panels.title: Last Successful Backup Age
panels.description: Time since the last successful backup. Alert fires at >25h (90 000s). A rising value without a new backup completing indicates the backup job is not running. See docs/backup-system.md.

panels.title: Last Successful Backup Timestamp
panels.description: Absolute time of the most recent successful backup. Compare against the BackupMissing alert threshold (25h).

panels.title: Backup Verification Status
panels.description: 1 = last verification passed, 0 = failed. A value of 0 fires BackupVerificationFailed immediately. Check scripts/verify_backup.sh output and docs/backup-system.md for remediation steps.

panels.title: Backup Verification Status History
panels.description: Historical view of backup verification outcomes. Repeated 0 values indicate a systemic integrity problem. A single 0 followed by 1 may be a transient checksum hiccup.

panels.title: Active Migration Progress
panels.description: Fraction of items migrated for each active migration job (migration_id). A value of 1.0 means the job is complete. A value stuck below 1.0 for >30m fires MigrationStalled.

panels.title: Migration Cursor Age
panels.description: Time since the migration cursor last advanced (time() - quorumproof_migration_last_progress_timestamp). If this exceeds 1800s (30m) for a job in InProgress status, MigrationStalled will fire. Check scripts/migration_orchestrator.py.

panels.title: Migration Status per Job
panels.description: status: 0 = InProgress, 1 = Completed. A job stuck at 0 with a stale cursor fires MigrationStalled.

panels.title: Migration Cursor Over Time
panels.description: Cursor should advance monotonically while a job is InProgress. A flat line for an extended period indicates a stalled orchestrator. The total_items line shows the target the cursor must reach.

panels.title: Contract State Version
panels.description: Should report a single consistent value across all exporter instances. More than one distinct value means a partial upgrade rollout or a stale exporter scraping an old deployment — fires StateVersionMismatch. A step change here marks an upgrade boundary; cross-reference with docs/contract-upgrade-strategy.md.

panels.title: State Version Cardinality (should be 1)
panels.description: Number of distinct quorumproof_state_version values currently being reported. Should always be 1. Any value >1 fires StateVersionMismatch immediately.

panels.title: State Version History
panels.description: Step changes mark upgrade or migration boundaries. Use this to correlate a StateVersionMismatch alert with a deployment event.
